HediffDef.label: spoken preparation vow
HediffDef.description: Permanently gain 25% cursed-technique output. Every cursed-energy cast requires three additional seconds of preparation and at least 50% Talking capacity. Losing your voice prevents casting.

JJKMod.BindingVowDef.label: spoken preparation vow

HediffDef.label: vow of protection
HediffDef.description: Swear to protect one named colonist. Gain 30% cursed-technique output within 12 cells of them on the same map. Their death, loss from your faction, or damage you inflict on them permanently breaks the vow: 25% less output and six days of grief. Distance suspends the benefit; the target cannot be changed.
